description: relay_client.rs:206-210: enforcing a 60-second minimum TTL regardless of max_age is correct. A malicious policy server could set max_age=0 to force a DNS+HTTPS re-fetch on every delivery attempt, turning the enforcer into an amplification tool. The minimum cap prevents this. A contributor might remove it as 'incorrect' since it deviates from max_age; it should not be removed.
title: Minimum 60-second cache TTL in load_fresh_policy prevents remote-controlled amplification
